## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] Python tests pass
- [ ] Frontend lint/tests/build pass when applicable
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changes
- [ ] No secrets or private data added
- [ ] Security impact considered
- [ ] Backwards compatibility considered

## Evidence

Include benchmark output, screenshots, logs, or reproducible steps when useful.

## Release impact

State whether this changes the public API, report schema, CLI behavior, or release policy semantics.
